original.not_on_bench: The STM32VLDISCOVERY is not on the bench. The expected behaviour is the upstream bootloader's documented behaviour, checked on the hand-written reference port first (runs/2026-10-20/EXPECTATION.md).

check.pass: Six checks over the console and the application area: the prompt and C until the first packet, an Xmodem-CRC update that ends in Firmware updated and the application running, the received bytes in flash at 0x00010000, the application starting after a reset, a NAK for a wrong CRC with the retry accepted, and CAN CAN after three errors with the prompt back.

mspm0g3519.flash: OpenOCD (xPack) over the XDS110, program and verify; the bootloader sits below 0x00010000. The check erases and dumps the application area through the probe, so it takes the probe lock itself (own_lock).
